speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the specific "telepathic" communications you're experiencing with animals? Are you hearing actual voices, or do you feel like you are intuitively knowing their thoughts?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others do not, or feeling that your thoughts are being controlled by external forces? speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Belief in telepathic communication with animals. I also have Ingestion of Peruvian herbs, No improvement with self-medication.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to rule out organic causes for these beliefs, so I will order some tests. REQUEST TEST: Urine Drug Screen, CBC, CMP, TSH, B12. Do you have any history of head trauma, seizures, or a family history of psychotic disorders?

speaker: Doctor
